lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har sa(n)t janaa kee jeevan ||
lines.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is the life of the humble Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhai ras bhog a(n)mrit sukh saagar raam naam ras peevan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Instead of enjoying corrupt pleasures, they drink in the Ambrosial Essence of the Name of the Lord, the Ocean of Peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਚਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੀਵਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)chan raam naam dhan ratanaa man tan bheetar seevan ||
lines.translation: They gather up the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name, and weave it into the fabric of their mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਂਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਲਾਲਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸ ਖੀਵਨਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har ra(n)g raa(n)g bhae man laalaa raam naam ras kheevan ||1||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, their minds are dyed in the deep crimson color of devotional love; they are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਉਰਝਾਨੋ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਵਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu meenaa jal siu urajhaano raam naam sa(n)g leevan ||
lines.translation: As the fish is immersed in water, they are absorbed in the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਥੀਵਨਿ ॥੨॥੬੮॥੯੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sa(n)t chaatrik kee niaaee har boo(n)d paan sukh theevan ||2||68||91||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Saints are like the rainbirds; they are comforted, drinking in the drops of the Lord's Name. ||2||68||91||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਬੇਤਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naamaheen betaal ||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, the mortal is a ghost.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਤੇਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jetaa karan karaavan tetaa sabh ba(n)dhan ja(n)jaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: All the actions he commits are just shackles and bonds. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਤ ਅਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਟੈ ਕਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin prabh sev karat an sevaa birathaa kaatai kaal ||
lines.translation: Without serving God, one who serves another wastes his time uselessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਬ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jab jam aai sa(n)ghaarai praanee tab tumaro kaun havaal ||1||
lines.translation: When the Messenger of Death comes to kill you, O mortal, what will your condition be then? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: raakh lehu daas apune kau sadaa sadaa kirapaal ||
lines.translation: Please protect Your slave, O Eternally Merciful Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥੨॥੬੯॥੯੨॥
lines.transliteration: sukh nidhaan naanak prabh meraa saadhasa(n)g dhan maal ||2||69||92||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my God is the Treasure of Peace; He is the wealth and property of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||69||92||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan raam ko biuhaar ||
lines.translation: My mind and body deal only in the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਨ ਗੀਧੇ ਪੋਹਤ ਨਹ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prem bhagat gun gaavan geedhe pohat nah sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Imbued with loving devotional worship, I sing His Glorious Praises; I am not affected by worldly affairs. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੋ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sravanee keeratan simaran suaamee ihu saadh ko aachaar ||
lines.translation: This is the way of life of the Holy Saint: he listens to the Kirtan, the Praises of his Lord and Master, and meditates in remembrance on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਸਥਿਤਿ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal asathit rid a(n)tar poojaa praan ko aadhaar ||1||
lines.translation: He implants the Lord's Lotus Feet deep within his heart; worship of the Lord is the support of his breath of life. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh deen daiaal sunahu bena(n)tee kirapaa apanee dhaar ||
lines.translation: O God, Merciful to the meek, please hear my prayer, and shower Your Blessings upon me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਉਚਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੭੦॥੯੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan ucharau nit rasanaa naanak sad balihaar ||2||70||93||
lines.translation: I continually chant the treasure of the Naam with my tongue; Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||2||70||93||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naamaheen mat thoree ||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, his intellect is shallow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਿਰੀਧਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਅੰਧ ਦੁਖ ਘੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarat naahi sireedhar thaakur milat a(n)dh dukh ghoree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He does not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, his Lord and Master; the blind fool suffers in terrible agony. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam siu preet na laagee anik bhekh bahu joree ||
lines.translation: He does not embrace love for the Name of the Lord; he is totally attached to various religious robes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂਟਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਿਉ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਜਲ ਫੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tootat baar na laagai taa kau jiu gaagar jal phoree ||1||
lines.translation: His attachments are shattered in an instant; when the pitcher is broken, the water runs out. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਮਨੁ ਖਚਿਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਖੋਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa bhagat ras deejai man khachit prem ras khoree ||
lines.translation: Please bless me, that I may worship You in loving devotion. My mind is absorbed and intoxicated with Your Delicious Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਹੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੭੧॥੯੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas teree saranaaee prabh bin aan na horee ||2||71||94||
lines.translation: Nanak, Your slave, has entered Your Sanctuary; without God, there is no other at all. ||2||71||94||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਵਾ ਅਉਸਰ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: chitavau vaa ausar man maahi ||
lines.translation: In my mind, I think about that moment,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi ikatr milahu sa(n)t saajan gun gobi(n)d nit gaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: when I join the Gathering of the Friendly Saints, constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਾਮ ਕਰੀਅਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਬਿਰਥੇ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin har bhajan jete kaam kareeahi tete birathe jaa(n)hi ||
lines.translation: Without vibrating and meditating on the Lord, whatever deeds you do will be useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pooran paramaana(n)d man meetho tis bin doosar naahi ||1||
lines.translation: The Perfect Embodiment of Supreme Bliss is so sweet to my mind. Without Him, there is no other at all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਧਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam karam sukh saadhan tul na kachhooai laahi ||
lines.translation: Chanting, deep meditation, austere self-discipline, good deeds and other techniques to being peace - they are not equal to even a tiny bit of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਚਰਨਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥੭੨॥੯੫॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal naanak man bedhio charanah sa(n)g samaahi ||2||72||95||
lines.translation: Nanak's mind is pierced through by the Lotus Feet of the Lord; it is absorbed in His Lotus Feet. ||2||72||95||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa prabh sa(n)ge a(n)tarajaamee ||
lines.translation: My God is always with me; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਪਾਛੈ ਖੇਮ ਸੂਖਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagai kusal paachhai khem sookhaa simarat naam suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I find happiness in the world hereafter, and peace and pleasure in this world, meditating in remembrance on the Name of my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
